H6000.name: Amal
H6000.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6000.short: Amal was a son of Helem, a descendant of Asher, and is listed in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

H6002H.name: Amalek
H6002H.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6002H.brief: Grandson of Esau, ancestor of the Amalekites
H6002H.short: Amalek was the son of Eliphaz and grandson of Esau, and he became the ancestor of the Amalekite people.

H6021H.name: Amasa
H6021H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6021H.brief: Ephraimite leader who opposed enslaving Judahite captives
H6021H.short: Amasa, along with other leaders of Ephraim, opposed the Israelite army's attempt to bring Judahite captives as slaves to Samaria.

H6021G.name: Amasa
H6021G.desc: Ishmaelite living at the time of United Monarchy
H6021G.brief: Military commander, son of Abigail (David's sister), killed by Joab
H6021G.short: Amasa, the son of Jether and Abigail (David's sister), was a military commander who served under Absalom and later David, but was killed by Joab.

H6022H.name: Amasai
H6022H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6022H.brief: Chief of thirty who joined David
H6022H.short: Amasai, a chief of thirty mighty men, joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

H6022I.name: Amasai
H6022I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6022I.short: Amasai, a priest, was among those who blew the trumpet when the Ark of the Covenant was brought to Jerusalem.

H6022G.name: Amasai
H6022G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6022G.short: Amasai, a Levite descended from Kohath, was an ancestor of the prophet Samuel.

H6022J.name: Amasai
H6022J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6022J.brief: Levite who helped purify the temple
H6022J.short: Amasai, a Levite of the sons of Merari, helped purify the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H6007.name: Amasiah
H6007.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6007.brief: Commander who volunteered for God's service
H6007.short: Amasiah, the son of Zichri, was a commander who willingly offered himself for the service of the Lord during the reign of King Jehoshaphat.

H6019G.name: Amram
H6019G.desc: Moses' father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6019G.brief: Father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam
H6019G.short: Amram was the father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, and a member of the tribe of Levi.

H6019H.name: Amram
H6019H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6019H.brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife
H6019H.short: Amram was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman during the Exile and agreed to put her away.

H6034.name: Anah
H6034.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6034.brief: Horite, father of Oholibamah, Esau's wife
H6034.short: Anah was a Horite, the father of Oholibamah, one of Esau's wives, and the discoverer of hot springs in the wilderness.

H6043H.name: Anaiah
H6043H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6043H.short: Anaiah was a priest who signed the covenant of faithfulness to God during Nehemiah's time.

H6043G.name: Anaiah
H6043G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6043G.brief: Stood beside Ezra during the reading of the Law
H6043G.short: Anaiah was one of the men who stood beside Ezra when he read the Book of the Law to the people.

H6061.name: Anak
H6061.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6061.brief: Ancestor of giant people in Canaan
H6061.short: Anak was the ancestor of the Anakim, a race of giants who inhabited Canaan before the Israelite conquest.

H6047.name: Anamim
H6047.brief: Descendants of Mizraim, son of Ham
H6047.short: The Anamim were a people group descended from Mizraim, the son of Ham, and are listed among the nations in the Table of Nations.

H6048.name: Anammelech
H6048.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6048.short: Anammelech was an Assyrian deity worshiped by the Sepharvites, who were among the foreign peoples settled in Samaria by the Assyrian king.

H6052.name: Anan
H6052.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6052.brief: Signer of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
H6052.short: Anan was one of the leaders who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

H6054.name: Anani
H6054.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6054.short: Anani was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy recorded in 1 Chronicles.

H6055G.name: Ananiah
H6055G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6055G.brief: Repairer of the wall in Jerusalem
H6055G.short: Ananiah made repairs to a section of the wall near his house during the rebuilding of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.

H6067.name: Anath
H6067.brief: Father of Shamgar, a judge of Israel
H6067.short: Anath was the father of Shamgar, one of the judges who delivered Israel from oppression.

H6068H.name: Anathoth
H6068H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6068H.brief: Son of Becher, descendant of Benjamin
H6068H.short: Anathoth was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

H6068I.name: Anathoth
H6068I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6068I.brief: Signer of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
H6068I.short: Anathoth was one of the leaders who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

H6063G.name: Aner
H6063G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6063G.short: Aner was an Amorite, one of the allies of Abram, who joined him in the battle against the kings who had taken Lot captive.

H6070.name: Anthothijah
H6070.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6070.brief: Son of Shashak, descendant of Benjamin
H6070.short: Anthothijah was a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

H6036.name: Anub
H6036.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6036.brief: Son of Coz, descendant of Judah
H6036.short: Anub was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

H6081H.name: Epher
H6081H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6081H.brief: Son of Ezrah, in the genealogy of Judah.
H6081H.short: Epher was one of the sons of Ezrah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H6081I.name: Epher
H6081I.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6081I.brief: A chief of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
H6081I.short: Epher was one of the heads of families and a mighty warrior in the half-tribe of Manasseh.

H6081G.name: Epher
H6081G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6081G.brief: Son of Midian and grandson of Abraham.
H6081G.short: Epher was one of the sons of Midian, who was a son of Abraham through Keturah.

H6085G.name: Ephron
H6085G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6085G.brief: A Hittite who sold a burial site to Abraham.
H6085G.short: Ephron the Hittite sold the cave of Machpelah to Abraham as a burial site for Sarah.

H6018J.name: Omri
H6018J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6018J.brief: Chief of the tribe of Issachar
H6018J.short: Omri was the chief of the tribe of Issachar during the reign of King David.

H6018H.name: Omri
H6018H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6018H.short: Omri was a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

H6018I.name: Omri
H6018I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6018I.short: Omri was a descendant of Judah who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

H6018G.name: Omri
H6018G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6018G.brief: King of Israel; father of Ahab
H6018G.short: Omri was the sixth king of Israel who established Samaria as the capital and founded a powerful dynasty.

H6084I.name: Ophrah
H6084I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6084I.short: Ophrah was the son of Meonothai, a descendant of Judah.

H6042G.name: Unni
H6042G.desc: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6042G.short: Unni was a Levite musician who played the harp and participated in the procession when the ark was brought to Jerusalem during David's reign.

H6042H.name: Unni
H6042H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6042H.brief: Postexilic Levite who assisted in the temple
H6042H.short: Unni was a postexilic Levite who assisted in the temple during the time of Nehemiah.

H6008.name: Amad
H6008.brief: A border town in the territory of Asher.
H6008.short: Amad, a town on the boundary of Asher's territory.

H6002G.name: Amalek
H6002G.brief: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.
H6002G.short: Amalek, a nomadic tribe descended from Esau, who were persistent enemies of Israel.

H6024.name: Anab
H6024.brief: A city in the hill country of Judah.
H6024.short: Anab, a town in Judah's hill country, captured by Joshua.

H6055H.name: Ananiah
H6055H.brief: A town inhabited by Benjamites after the Babylonian exile.
H6055H.short: Ananiah, a town settled by the Benjamites after the exile.

H6068G.name: Anathoth
H6068G.brief: A Levitical city in Benjamin, home of the prophet Jeremiah.
H6068G.short: Anathoth, a Levitical city in Benjamin, notable as the birthplace of Jeremiah.

H6044.name: Anim
H6044.brief: A city in the hill country of Judah.
H6044.short: Anim, a town allotted to Judah in the hill country.

H6049G.name: Diviners' Oak
H6049G.brief: A tree near Shechem, associated with pagan divination practices.
H6049G.short: The Diviners' Oak was a tree near Shechem, likely associated with pagan divination practices (<ref="Judges 9:37">Judges 9:37</ref>).

H6010J.name: Emek-keziz
H6010J.short: Emek-keziz, a town within the territory allotted to the tribe of Benjamin.

H6085H.name: Ephron Mount
H6085H.brief: Mountain on the border between Judah and Benjamin
H6085H.short: Mount Ephron, a mountain on the border between the territories of Judah and Benjamin, near Kiriath-jearim.

H6017.name: Gomorrah
H6017.brief: Wicked city destroyed by God along with Sodom.
H6017.short: Gomorrah was a wicked city in the plain of Jordan that God destroyed with sulfur and fire, along with Sodom, due to their grave sins.

H6077.name: Ophel
H6077.short: Ophel was a fortified area in Jerusalem, located near the temple, and was inhabited by temple servants during the time of Nehemiah.

H6078.name: Ophni
H6078.short: Ophni was a town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin during the division of the Promised Land.

H6084G.name: Ophrah
H6084G.brief: A town in Benjamin and a place in Manasseh
H6084G.short: Ophrah was a town in Benjamin and a place in Manasseh, associated with Gideon and mentioned in a prophecy of Micah.

H6084H.name: Ophrah
H6084H.brief: Gideon's hometown in Manasseh; a town in Issachar
H6084H.short: Ophrah, also known as Hapharaim, was Gideon's hometown in Manasseh and the site of important events during his time as a judge, as well as a town allotted to the tribe of Issachar.
